name: STARK
description: A laparoscopic surgical robot developed by LIVSMED. The system features a modular architecture consisting of two carts, each equipped with two robotic arms (four arms total). It utilizes the 90° articulating multi-joint technology from LIVSMED's ArtiSential handheld instrument line, and is designed to support remote telesurgery operations. Long-distance telesurgery has been demonstrated in trials between Santa Barbara and Chicago. As of mid-2026, the system is in a pre-commercial phase with animal clinical trials underway.
